text:
inc-bot: [P1] TrilonBank (enterprise VPC) - spike in websocket disconnects and streaming stalls detected. Affected sessions: ~15% over 6m. Symptoms: repeated ECONNRESET from router, frequent keepalive timeouts. Paging @oliver_oncall :rotating_light:

oliver_oncall: ACK. Pulling logs and checking recent infra changes. Anyone see deploys in last 12h to trilon-dedicated-2?

ashley_ops: No deploys in that dedicated pool. Alert started at 2026-02-12T22:10:03Z. Trilon escalation: users see checkout streams drop mid-flow.

raj_runtime: Tailing router and gateway logs from trilon-dedicated-2. Snippet:

```
2026-02-12T22:09:52Z router[trilon-dedicated-2] WARN ws: read error: EOF
2026-02-12T22:09:55Z router[trilon-dedicated-2] WARN upstream=appgw-trilon write timeout
2026-02-12T22:09:58Z router[trilon-dedicated-2] WARN kvcache: lock_wait > 200ms
2026-02-12T22:10:01Z router[trilon-dedicated-2] ERROR conn=xyza9876 ws closed by server
```

kevin_network: Seeing increased packet retransmits on the interconnect to customer peering for a small subset of internal egress IPs. Latency is more jittery than normal. No provider maintenance flagged.

maria_csm: Trilon CSM reports customers seeing intermittent stalls; they want immediate ETA and whether data transited outside VPC.

oliver_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) scale trilon-dedicated-2 by +30% capacity (hot-spare nodes) to reduce per-host pressure. 2) apply tenant circuit-breaker to limit retry storms from client SDKs. 3) enable streaming->polling downgrade for active sessions older than 45s. I'll execute 1 and 3.

ashley_ops: Scaling nodes now: `autoscale trilon-dedicated-2 +3 nodes` executed at 22:14:10Z.

raj_runtime: Applying tenant-level circuit-breaker: `tenant.trilon.circuit_breaker.max_concurrent_streams=150` and `max_retries=3` at 22:15:00Z. Also turning on streaming downgrade for sessions with >45s idle at 22:15:30Z.

inc-bot: Mitigations applied by oliver_oncall/raj_runtime at 2470011250. Monitoring metrics.

trilon_infra: After scaling and circuit-breaker, our customer telemetry shows a drop in immediate disconnects but still seeing a tail of 4xx/5xx during page transitions. Concern: some long-lived sessions still get closed mid-chunk.

raj_runtime: Found significant kvcache pressure and mutex contention on router worker 2. Heap samples show heavy GC and a hot path in cache eviction triggered by rapid retry loops from client library. Proposed ephemeral fix: relax eviction aggressiveness for tenant trilon and add jitter to retry handling.

oliver_oncall: Apply ephemeral fix to tenant only. We must avoid cross-tenant risk. Also ask Trilon to push a minor SDK update to reduce aggressive reconnects. Maria please coordinate.

maria_csm: Reached out to Trilon product; they're willing to coordinate SDK change but need immediate mitigations. They asked whether we can route only their streaming traffic to hosted fallback while keeping control plane in VPC.

raj_runtime: We can do a targeted streaming proxy in hosted with VPC-preserve flag (no payload egress) for streaming-only endpoints. That buys time. I can stand that up and route streams there. Estimated 18m to deploy safe fallback.

kevin_network: Note: provider ticket opened to analyze retransmits. Also discovered MTU mismatch on one peering node that could cause fragmentation and retransmits. Sending packet captures to provider now. ETA 45m for initial analysis.

oliver_oncall: Do the hosted streaming proxy. While that's staging, keep dedicated pool scaled and keep circuit-breaker. Maria draft a customer note explaining temporary isolated streaming fallback and confirmation on data handling.

maria_csm: Draft to Trilon sent at 22:34Z: "We are routing streaming connections through a temporary, customer-scoped streaming proxy in our hosted plane to stabilize sessions. Control plane and customer data remain under your VPC tenancy; payloads are proxied but not logged beyond connection metadata. Expect intermittent reconnects while we stabilize. More updates in 30m."

inc-bot: Metric update at 2470011450: websocket disconnect rate down 65% after proxy partial rollout. Overall error rate reduced from 12% -> 3.5% for streaming flows.

trilon_infra: Customer reports improved session stability; some longer sessions still drop occasionally during heavy checkout operations. Asking for timeline to restore normal dedicated pool behavior.

raj_runtime: Rolling configuration change to reduce eviction aggressiveness for trilon at 22:46Z and adding 150-300ms jitter to retry backoff. Monitoring shows lock_waits reduced.

ashley_ops: Verified node health after autoscale; new nodes healthy and traffic redistributed. No pod OOMs observed.

kevin_network: Cloud provider found MTU mismatch causing fragmentation on one peering node. They are provisioning config fix and expect completion in ~40min. This aligns with observed retransmit windows.

oliver_oncall: Good. Plan: keep hosted streaming proxy active as safety for 2h, maintain tenant circuit-breaker and adjusted kvcache settings, and await network fix. Postmortem and root cause to include network MTU mismatch + runtime eviction under retry storms.

maria_csm: Trilon acknowledged. They requested evidence we're not capturing payloads. Ashley confirmed logs are connection-level only.

raj_runtime: I'll open PR to make tenant circuit-breaker defaults more conservative for streaming-enabled tenants: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4199. Also capturing router worker heap profile for deeper GC analysis (ETA 3h).

inc-bot: Impact lowered to medium at 2470011675. Ongoing monitoring.

oliver_oncall: Handing over to daytime oncall. Action items:
- raj_runtime: followup GC/heap analysis & PR.
- ashley_ops: keep autoscaled nodes for 2h, unscale if stable.
- kevin_network: follow up with provider ticket until MTU fix verified.
- maria_csm: coordinate postmortem with Trilon and confirm legal/PII note.

trilon_infra: We'll join postmortem. Appreciate the scoped proxy option.

inc-bot: Incident mitigated for immediate customer-facing streaming outages at 2470011950. Severity: P1->Mitigated. Postmortem required.

oliver_oncall: Final: root cause likely combo of peering MTU mismatch causing retransmits + tenant runtime kvcache eviction under retry storms. Temporary measures: scoped hosted streaming proxy (no payload logging), tenant circuit-breaker, eviction tuning and autoscaling. Follow-ups: PR for tenant defaults, heap profile & GC tuning, provider confirm MTU fix. Handoff to @sara_oncall_day.

sara_oncall_day: ACK. Taking follow-ups and scheduling postmortem. I'll update the incident ticket with notes and owners.

maria_csm: Sent Trilon scheduling invite for RCA call. Thanks team.
